label: Mid-copy steps (outputting original tokens 3-4) of long sequences, boosted when the fed-back input is i/o/x/f/d/r
explanation: Fires only during the copy phase, never on original tokens or the delimiter. It is concentrated at recall_idx 3-4 (about 90% of mass), which is t=11-13 in practice, and on long sequences (L=9 gives 58% of mass, L=8 31%, nothing for L<=5). On steps with this timing, the identity of the fed-back input token modulates it strongly: i, o, x (then f, d, r) have 4-6x lift, and the strongest activations are i or o inputs around recall 3. The timing condition alone has high recall (0.84 for L>=7) but precision is only about 0.11. Adding the token set raises precision to about 0.37 at recall 0.57 and mass recall 0.68. The remaining dependence on context is spread across many tokens and the predicate does not capture it. Zero activity in the original or delimiter phases, at recall_idx 0-1, or for L<=5.
